test_title: PYST 67: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 27 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: At which summit did India’s NSA Ajit Doval push for a unified counter‑terrorism stance in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SCO Summit in China**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• During the meeting of the National Security Advisers (NSAs) of the **Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO)** held in **China** in **June 2025**, India’s NSA **Ajit Doval** strongly advocated for a **unified counter-terrorism stance** among member nations.
 
• He emphasized that the **SCO** must strictly adhere to the principle of **zero tolerance** for terrorism in all its forms and manifestations, including **cross-border terrorism** and the financing of terror activities.
 
• NSA **Ajit Doval** called for the strengthening of the **Regional Anti-Terrorist Structure (RATS)**, which is the permanent organ of the **SCO** headquartered in **Tashkent**, to enhance **intelligence sharing** and technical cooperation.
 
• He also highlighted the rising threat of **cyber-terrorism** and the use of **emerging technologies** like **drones** and **artificial intelligence** by terror groups, urging the **SCO** to develop a collaborative framework to counter these **asymmetric threats**.
 
• The **June 2025** summit served as a platform where **India** reiterated its stand on **territorial integrity** and **sovereignty**, particularly concerning **connectivity projects** within the **Eurasian** region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO):**
 
 
• Established in **June 2001** in **Shanghai**, it is a permanent intergovernmental international organization.
 
• The current members include **China**, **Russia**, **India**, **Pakistan**, **Kazakhstan**, **Kyrgyzstan**, **Tajikistan**, **Uzbekistan**, and **Iran**.
 
• **India** and **Pakistan** became **permanent members** in **2017** during the **Astana Summit**. The headquarters of the **SCO Secretariat** is located in **Beijing**.
 
 
 
• **G20 Summit:**
 
 
• The **G20** is a premier forum for **international economic cooperation**. **India** successfully hosted the **18th G20 Summit** in **New Delhi** in **September 2023** under the theme **Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam**.
 
• The **2025 G20 Summit** is scheduled to be hosted by **South Africa**, not **New Delhi**. ***Hence, option 2 is incorrect.***
 
 
 
• **ASEAN Summit:**
 
 
• The **Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN)** is a regional grouping that promotes **economic**, **political**, and **security cooperation** among its **10 member states** in **Southeast Asia**.
 
• While **India** is a **dialogue partner**, the **ASEAN Summit** focuses primarily on **Indo-Pacific** stability and **maritime security**. ***Hence, option 3 is incorrect.***
 
 
 
• **EU Summit:**
 
 
• The **European Union (EU) Summit** (or **European Council**) is held in **Brussels**, **Belgium**, where heads of state of **EU** members meet to define **political directions**.
 
• **India** engages with the **EU** through **India-EU Summits**, but the primary security focus for **NSA Ajit Doval** in **June 2025** was the **Eurasian** security architecture. ***Hence, option 1 is incorrect.***
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **SECURE Strategy:** At various **SCO** meetings, **India** has proposed the **SECURE** acronym: **S**ecurity for citizens, **E**conomic development, **C**onnectivity in the region, **U**nity, **R**espect for sovereignty and integrity, and **E**nvironment protection.
 
• **Counter-Terrorism Mechanisms:** The **RATS-SCO** remains the most vital mechanism for **counter-terror** cooperation, where **India** has consistently pushed for the adoption of a **Comprehensive Convention on International Terrorism (CCIT)** at the **United Nations** level.
 
• **NSA's Role:** The **National Security Advisor** is the **primary advisor** to the **Prime Minister** of **India** on **national** and **international security** policy, currently held by **Ajit Doval**, an **IPS officer** of the **1968 batch**.
